summary: The Apex Financial agent called about an overdue personal loan of $4,500. The customer expressed anger, stated they are bankrupt, and requested all future contact be through their attorney, David Miller (555-0198). The agent recorded the attorney's details and agreed to cease direct outreach.

decisions.text: Suspend direct outreach to the customer and cease direct contact

source_excerpts.text: Customer: Oh god, you people again. Stop calling me! I told you guys not to call me at work!
Agent: Thank you. I have noted attorney David Miller, 555-0198, on your file and will suspend direct outreach immediately. Have a good day.
